## Icons

Line icons are Phosphor (regular and fill) from github.com/phosphor-icons/core at the commit recorded in
`vendor/phosphor/manifest.json`, MIT licence. Only the SVG path data of the concepts in
`hq/design/icons/map.json` is embedded (`Sources/LAATokens/LAAIcon.generated.swift`); the licence text
follows. SF Symbols are referenced by name only and drawn by the system on Apple platforms (Apple SDK
licence); the web projection names icons but does not ship them.

## Code

All Swift, CSS and TypeScript in this package is written by LAA. The particle orb and the model/effort
picker were consolidated from LAA-authored files in Hortensia (`dev/hermes-conduit/Conduit/LAA/`) and
Campanula (`dev/voice-input`); no upstream (third-party) source is copied.

## Images

The marble textures in `Sources/LAAKit/Resources/Marble` are LAA-made and byte-identical to the ones
already published in Hortensia (`assets/laa/LAAAccent.xcassets`). Consumers that vendor a snapshot
(scripts/snapshot.py) carry this file and `SNAPSHOT.json` with it.
